protocol.oracle: Reuse previous V4 trajectories and fits without refitting; previous RC bounds up to 100000s differ from new fits and are explicitly reported.
protocol.data: Same loaders, raw files, independent OCV artifacts and positive-discharge convention as lfp_gonogo; no writes to previous outputs.
protocol.simulator: Reuse exact continuous zero-order-hold 2RC simulator, initial polarization zero, one state per complete profile.
protocol.ocv: V1/V6 fixed OCV_mean; V5/V7 degree-9 Chebyshev on [0,1], same common-interval boundary hold as previous V4.
protocol.soc: z=z0-net_Ah/Q; no cycle-end normalization, no inverse OCV. V6/V7 fitted Q and z0 transfer unchanged from DST to both targets (user confirmed).
protocol.stratification: Identical original loader-SOC masks for all models, including V6/V7, to preserve comparable sample sets; fitted SOC trajectories and ranges also saved.

bounds.report_near_bound: distance to nearest finite bound divided by bound width < 0.0001 in optimizer coordinates
bounds.branch_labels: Bound both taus to prevent label-switch evasion; report branches sorted fast-to-slow, slow tau2=max(tau1,tau2)<=3600.

optimizer.selection: Lowest full-DST squared residual among converged predetermined starts; no target tuning.

decision.positive: For EACH of FUDS and US06, min(MAE_V5,MAE_V6,MAE_V7) <= 0.75*MAE_V1. The best model can differ between targets, as requested.
decision.ceiling_fraction: (MAE_V1-MAE_Vk)/(MAE_V1-MAE_previous_V4); unbounded signed ratio, not clipped. Nonpositive denominator is explicitly flagged as unavailable, never silently replaced.
decision.attribution: Per target compare recovered fractions V6 versus V5: V6>V5 SOC, V5>V6 OCV, equality tie. Both SOC => SOC, both OCV => OCV; otherwise mixed/inconclusive (user confirmed). If ceiling denominator nonpositive, attribution unavailable.
decision.global: Static transfer positive iff primary A positive; replica B cannot change global result.

loader.selection: Lexicographically first specimen, chosen before fitting; A1-008 preserved and inventoried, not pooled or selected by performance.
loader.raw_current_sign: positive charge, negative discharge verified against counters/CCCV
loader.qnom_method: trapezoidal current integration, low-current discharge step5 only
caveats: A1-007 selected deterministically; A1-008 not a pooled replicate.
Low-current OCV recorded after dynamic test date; aging between dates not measured.
Low-current voltage approximates OCV and includes polarization.
120s rest: initial RC voltages assumed zero, not estimated from target.
Capacity varies by rate; no cycle-end target capacity is used for SOC.
Charge covers slightly less Ah than discharge; boundary hold declared.

DST.initial_state_provenance: documented CCCV to 3.6V, taper <0.06A, followed by 120s rest
DST.profile_identity: DST: ordered archive schedule and 360s excitation followed by 1s repeated-rest step

DST.resampling: linear I/V/T to 1s; trapezoidal current integration; no capacity-counter resets
DST.boundary_policy: unclipped causal SOC, no target-end capacity normalization

Low-current OCV recorded after dynamic test date; aging between dates not measured.
Low-current voltage approximates OCV and includes polarization.
120s rest: initial RC voltages assumed zero, not estimated from target.

V1 reidentified under3600s RC bound, not the previous V1 numbers.
